clips.send: Simplified model: the building is treated as a spring that sways back and forth. Taller buildings sway more slowly; when the ground shakes at the building’s own rhythm (resonance), it sways most. The magnitude-8 test adds slow, long-period rolling as well as fast shaking — tough on tall towers. Real seismic design is far more complex.

The Wenchuan quake was magnitude 8.0; near its epicentre the intensity reached XI on China’s 12-level scale.
